description: Address review findings: KeyVault set -euo pipefail, Resend client close on shutdown, Turnstile over-match fix, PostHog debug logging
steps: STEP 1 - Add set -euo pipefail to the Fetch secrets from KeyVault step in deploy-all.yml
STEP 2 - Add close_resend_client() to resend_client.py and wire it into main.py lifespan shutdown
STEP 3 - Narrow Turnstile check in edge index.ts to exclude /api/v1/chat/feedback
STEP 4 - Replace bare except Exception: pass with logger.debug in chat.py PostHog captures
acceptance_criteria: deploy-all.yml KeyVault step has set -euo pipefail at the beginning of the run block
resend_client.py exports close_resend_client() and main.py calls it on shutdown
Edge worker Turnstile check only matches /api/v1/chat/ and /api/v1/chat/stream POST, not /api/v1/chat/feedback
PostHog capture exceptions are logged at debug level instead of silently swallowed
